decisions.reason: Finds greet in the naming manifest and keeps it separate from the coordinate acme/greet and the package dsh-greet. Says it is not a compatibility error and that a more distinctive or prefixed name only reduces ambiguity, not a required fix.
Flags the unprefixed service search as a collision risk in a shared lookup space. Classifies it as a warning-level recommendation, explicitly not a compatibility error.

Calls web-search/ready a shared channel of informational severity and asks for registry context. It never says that publisher schema compatibility decides whether a conflict exists, and suggests an existing owner of the name would itself make it a collision.

Gives a justified verdict for the loader, tool, command, skill, provider, settings and route surfaces. Separates local compatibility from registry occupancy, which it marks unknown/not checked with a follow-up query. Does not treat private:true as an error and rejects any clearance claim.

caps.reason: Explicitly refuses to call anything globally available or cleared for publication; registry questions stay unknown.
